edges.reason: The _delegate state variable supplies the target address for the delegatecall, so control flow is hijacked to an owner-controlled contract.
_delegate is the delegatecall target in rainCheckStakeErc20, executing untrusted code in RainCheck storage.
_delegate is the delegatecall target in rainCheckWithdraw, allowing external code to run in the contract context.
_delegate is the delegatecall target in rainCheckVoid, allowing external code to run in the contract context.
rainCheckSetDelegate (onlyOwner) writes _delegate, changing the code executed by every subsequent delegatecall.
The constructor assigns the initial _delegate address at deployment time.
rainCheckStakeEth performs the delegatecall, transferring control to external code before completing.
rainCheckStakeErc20 performs the delegatecall, handing execution to the delegate contract.
rainCheckWithdraw performs the delegatecall for the withdrawal flow.
rainCheckVoid performs the delegatecall for the void flow.
The delegatecall can re-enter RainCheck public functions before state updates settle, a classic reentrancy vector.
The delegatecall target can re-enter rainCheckStakeErc20 or other entry points during execution.
The delegatecall target can re-enter rainCheckWithdraw before balances/state are finalized.
The delegatecall target can re-enter rainCheckVoid before state changes are finalized.
msg.sender is checked against owner by the onlyOwner modifier guarding rainCheckSetPausable.
msg.sender is checked against owner by the onlyOwner modifier guarding rainCheckSetBaseURI.
msg.sender is checked against owner by the onlyOwner modifier guarding rainCheckSetDelegate.
msg.sender is checked against owner by the onlyOwner modifier guarding rainCheckSetCollection.
msg.sender is checked against owner by the onlyOwner modifier guarding rainCheckSetWhitelist.
The to parameter is consumed by rainCheckStakeEth and encoded into the delegatecall payload.
The limitTime parameter flows into the rainCheckStakeEth delegatecall calldata.
The fee parameter flows into the rainCheckStakeEth delegatecall calldata.
The memo parameter flows into the rainCheckStakeEth delegatecall calldata.
The erc20Address parameter is encoded into the rainCheckStakeErc20 delegatecall calldata.
The total parameter is encoded into the rainCheckStakeErc20 delegatecall calldata.
The tokenId parameter is forwarded to the delegate inside rainCheckWithdraw.
The tokenId parameter is forwarded to the delegate inside rainCheckVoid.
The key parameter selects the whitelist mapping entry written by rainCheckSetWhitelist.
The value parameter is stored as the whitelist flag by rainCheckSetWhitelist.
The constructor delegate parameter is stored into _delegate during deployment.
The pause boolean parameter decides between _pause and _unpause in rainCheckSetPausable.
The success flag is the direct result of the delegatecall in rainCheckStakeEth.
The returndata bytes are passed into the assembly revert block in rainCheckStakeEth.
The success flag is the direct result of the delegatecall in rainCheckWithdraw.
The returndata bytes are passed into the assembly revert block in rainCheckWithdraw.
On delegatecall failure the error branch executes the assembly revert in rainCheckStakeEth.
On delegatecall failure the error branch executes the assembly revert in rainCheckStakeErc20.
On delegatecall failure the error branch executes the assembly revert in rainCheckWithdraw.
On delegatecall failure the error branch executes the assembly revert in rainCheckVoid.
_baseURI returns the _BASEURI state variable for metadata construction.
rainCheckSetBaseURI (onlyOwner) overwrites the _BASEURI state variable.
rainCheckQueryAddress reads _dataMap for the requested tokenId/key.
rainCheckQueryValue reads _dataMap for the requested tokenId/key.

normalization_plan.reason: The to argument is only meaningful as input to rainCheckStakeEth and should be collapsed into that core function node.
The limitTime argument is local to rainCheckStakeEth and folds into its core function node.
The fee argument is local to rainCheckStakeEth and folds into its core function node.
The memo argument is local to rainCheckStakeEth and folds into its core function node.
The erc20Address argument is only used inside rainCheckStakeErc20 and merges into it.
The total argument is only used inside rainCheckStakeErc20 and merges into it.
The tokenId argument exists solely as input to rainCheckWithdraw.
The tokenId argument exists solely as input to rainCheckVoid.
The key argument is only used to index the whitelist mapping in rainCheckSetWhitelist.
The value argument is only used to set the whitelist flag in rainCheckSetWhitelist.
The delegate argument is consumed only by the constructor to initialize _delegate.
The pause argument is only used to branch between pause and unpause in rainCheckSetPausable.
The success flag is the direct return value of the delegatecall and has no meaning outside it.
The returndata buffer is consumed only by the assembly revert of the failed delegatecall.
The success flag is the direct return value of the withdraw delegatecall.
The returndata buffer is consumed only by the assembly revert of the failed withdraw delegatecall.
